latest_release.name: v0.404.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* docker: don't raise on versions with more than one underscore-separated group by @v-sachin-sandhu in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16660
* Enable Sorbet checking for Go modules specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16732
* Enable Sorbet checking for pub specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16733
* Enable Sorbet checking for pre-commit specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16734
* terraform: don't crash when the lockfile has no entry for the updated provider by @v-sachin-sandhu in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16667
* julia: report the running Julia as the language version by @IanButterworth in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16600
* go_modules: report an import that no module provides as an unresolvable file by @v-sachin-sandhu in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16742
* Add missing PR labeler entries for julia, conda, bazel, nix, sbt, pre… by @v-sachin-sandhu in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16752
* Enable Sorbet checking for NuGet Ruby specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16739
* Enable Sorbet checking for Bazel specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16748
* Enable Sorbet checking for vcpkg specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16749
* NuGet: fetch release notes and package URLs concurrently by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16755
* github_actions: give pinned-ref clone failures a stable fingerprint by @v-sachin-sandhu in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16718
* opentofu: lock only the platforms the new provider version ships by @v-sachin-sandhu in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16690
* python, uv: do not match the start of a longer declaration of the same package by @v-sachin-sandhu in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16753
* NuGet: treat empty existing PR directory as wildcard on refresh by @v-thavaahariharangit with @Copilot in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16760
* Fix Composer implicit PHP requirement retries by @v-thavaahariharangit in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16747
* helm: ask the registry for the image path without its host name by @v-sachin-sandhu in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16706
* julia: resolve a manifest for its Julia version with Pkg instead of juliaup by @IanButterworth in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16591
* julia: report a version for a stdlib in the PR body by @IanButterworth in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16716
* Enable Sorbet checking for Nix specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16768
* Enable Sorbet checking for Elm specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16769
* Enable Sorbet checking for Hex specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16770
* Enable Sorbet checking for Composer specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16772
* Enable Sorbet checking for Swift specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16773
* Enable Sorbet checking for Julia specs by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16774
* python: report a poetry.lock that Poetry cannot read as a file that does not resolve by @v-sachin-sandhu in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16767
* Add support for Python 3.15 by @amnesiaof in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16525
* Bump gh-actions-lock to v0.4.1 by @nodeselector in https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/pull/16799
* Enable Sorbet checking for Bundler specs by @JamieMagee in https://gith
